description: A controlled multiline list input that preserves unfinished text, with optional file selection and explicit tokenization helpers.

## Overview

Paste or type a list without losing unfinished entries. Optional file selection delegates parsing to the host. parseBulkList splits comma/newline text and deduplicates using optional normalization; it is not a CSV parser or domain validator. Extracted from Kokobi. See /docs/bulk-list-input for examples and API reference.
